sentences.text: IBAC reviewed how Victoria Police responded to its recommendations to improve transparency and accountability.
sentences.support: an opportunity to increase transparency and accountability around Victoria Police’s responses to recommendations

sentences.text: It analysed responses to 104 recommendations made between January 2016 and March 2022, including implementation, timeliness, discipline and systemic risks.
sentences.support: IBAC analysed how Victoria Police responded to 104 recommendations

sentences.text: IBAC reported that Victoria Police accepted 92 per cent of its recommendations.
sentences.support: Victoria Police accepted 92 per cent of the 104 recommendations
sentences.section: Victoria Police accepted and implemented most of IBAC’s recommendations

sentences.text: After excluding rejected recommendations and those still unfinished, IBAC assessed 98 per cent as fully or partly implemented.
sentences.support: IBAC assessed that Victoria Police had implemented or partially implemented 98 per cent of recommendations
sentences.section: Victoria Police accepted and implemented most of IBAC’s recommendations

sentences.text: IBAC found that police usually reported late on implementation and identified persistent risks in force reporting, conflicts of interest, notetaking and statement making.
sentences.support: Victoria Police is usually late when reporting on the implementation of recommendations to IBAC
sentences.section: Key findings about recommendations to Victoria Police

findings.quote: Excluding rejected recommendations and recommendations not finalised as of 1 November 2022, IBAC assessed that Victoria Police had implemented or partially implemented 98 per cent of recommendations.
Victoria Police is usually late when reporting on the implementation of recommendations to IBAC.

notes: Review scope excludes requests arising from reviews of police misconduct investigations. This report reviews existing recommendations rather than issuing a new numbered recommendations list. The implementation percentage excludes rejected recommendations and those not finalised at 1 November 2022, and includes partial implementation.
